svg.title: Té Company Golden Ticket — gold paper and reflective foil
svg.desc: Gold, white-gold and silver foil ink with outlined lettering, teapot illustration, speech balloon, border, and Té Co stamp. The gold paper is built from seeded vector flakes, fibers, and micrograin. No photograph, bitmap, raster filter, or font is required. You my lucky friend, are holding a golden ticket from Té Company! In other words you are… the chosen one.
